# Self-hosted map libraries (D-193)

| Files | Package | License | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maplibre-gl.mjs`, `maplibre-gl-shared.mjs`, `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs`, `maplibre-gl.css` | `maplibre-gl` 6.4.1 (the version `maplibre_gl` 0.27.1 is written against) | BSD-3-Clause, `LICENSE-maplibre-gl.txt` | `maplibre-gl.mjs`: `97e8b9a39ab8b823d6a0caf9c312237262bc9138a6162d9e29606f5f8d24127d` |
| `pmtiles.js` | `pmtiles` 4.5.0 | BSD-3-Clause | `caf981bc46f6327ee7e65d5dc964d89d38a69f60edca2bd4c5c890c21b554c6c` |

When `maplibre_gl` is upgraded, update these files to the version in its `kMapLibreJsVersion`.
